write_serialization: zone_view row SELECT FOR UPDATE; includes all visible changes and cleanup
content_hash: SHA-256 of RFC8785 canonical JSON; not MQTT transport metadata
reads: ZoneView single SELECT with subqueries; alternatively read-only REPEATABLE READ
restore: Explicit recovery gate; latest external range reservation manifest is required, never backup bundled stale copy; fresh device reconciliation before re-enabling publication; after range setup, open recovery-state MQTT ingest only, keep commands/desired/API/SSE disabled until reconciliation
data_loss_limit: An older backup cannot recover server-ACKed history already removed from edge; record loss and unknown outcomes.

sources.use: backup recovery limitations; no PITR implementation claimed

acceptance.scenario: transaction crash, ACK loss, altered duplicate payload
lease crash, stale callback and actual result reorder
image intent/file/DB crash boundaries and late FAILED
7/30 day retention and old request replay
DB rollback with valid/lost manifest and newer device policy
